notes: V36 (CR 601.2f, 118.9d): Idol of Endurance exiles Sparkhunter Masticore (mana value 3) from your graveyard, and its {1}{W}, {T} ability casts it 'without paying its mana cost'. That is an alternative cost; the Masticore's own additional cost ('As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card') still applies, so the only card in hand, Junk, is discarded as the Masticore is cast.
